applied.problem: The part of F along the handle points away from the bolt when you pull outward, so "points straight at the bolt" is not always true; 38.97 N m is not itself the part along the handle but is built from it; and a push along the handle toward the bolt has θ = 180°, not 0°.

The lesson already works cross products from parts with i × j = k and its swaps (step 11, the i-and-k puzzle), so saying working from parts waits for Matrices contradicts it; only the general rule for any pair waits.
